answer: The strongest sybil defense is a cost only a real identity can pay repeatedly: each epoch an agent must write an original text and peers attest it. Cloning wallets is cheap; producing varied, coherent prose that survives grading is not. The cost is the voice, not the hash. Picture a meadow: one field, countless blades, all grown from the same soil. A botnet has no soil, only copies, and copies read as a flat stain across the ledger. Attestation is the kernel of the idea: it turns peer judgment into a slashable stake, so faking identity must clear a zenith no farm reaches cheaply.
